These schedules are generated by the real RetrainingPlanner(...).plan("exact") using supplied synthetic costs. The optimizer sees all 24 steps in advance and minimizes the objective over the configured sample choices. This illustrates the decision problem; it is not a measured performance benchmark or a forecast.

Every policy starts with the same full-data model. “Every 6 steps” has a fixed interval, not an interval selected after seeing the results. No model is fitted for this demo; the loss and training-price formulas are documented in how it works.
